senses.sense_definition: Very unwilling to spend money or use resources.

examples.text: He was so <w>parsimonious</w> that he refused to buy even the most basic necessities for his home.
The company's <w>parsimonious</w> budget meant that employees had to share office supplies for months.

senses.sense_definition: Using the simplest or fewest possible explanations or steps to reach a conclusion.

examples.text: Scientists prefer a <w>parsimonious</w> model that explains the data without unnecessary complexity.
The researcher provided a <w>parsimonious</w> explanation for the sudden change in the experiment results.

senses.sense_definition: Rarely allowing the opposing team to score goals.

examples.text: The team relied on their <w>parsimonious</w> defense to win the championship title this year.
Despite the pressure, the <w>parsimonious</w> goalkeeper kept a clean sheet throughout the entire tournament.
